parties: Indo National Limited (acquirer); Aidin Technologies Private Limited (target)
headline: Indo National acquires 51% controlling stake in defence-electronics firm Aidin Technologies
sum: Indo National Limited acquired a 51% controlling stake in Bengaluru-based Aidin Technologies Private Limited for ₹78.05 crore through compulsorily convertible preference shares (CCPS) in two tranches. The transaction, approved by Indo National's board on 30 April 2026, marks the listed consumer battery maker's strategic entry into the high-growth defence electronics sector.
implication: Preference-share-funded minority acquisition with staged earn-in structure; continued-shareholder carve-out via shareholders' agreement precedent for founder retention in defensive-tech buyouts.
detail: Indo National subscribed to 9,920 Series A fully paid CCPS and 12,202 Series A-1 partly paid CCPS at face value ₹10 plus premium ₹35,270.84 each. Tranche 1 (31.82%, ₹34.99 cr) completed 29 July 2026; Tranche 2 (₹43.05 cr) due within 12 months, ensuring minimum 51% on full dilution. Aidin (incorporated 2008) designs RF power electronics and embedded systems for electronic warfare, defence communications, satellites, and anti-drone systems; FY25 turnover ₹74.3 cr (169% YoY growth). Bharath Kumar, existing shareholder, retained minority stake and was advised on shareholders' agreement safeguarding.

Tranche 2 completion within 12 months of Tranche 1
